name: 第13窟 · 东崖大佛局部
prompt: Color this EXACT sparse black ink drawing, using photo 2 for actual present material color and image 3 as subdued matte atlas illustration style only. Subject: Maijishan Cave 13 East Cliff Buddha partial figure, sandstone and clay in sand ochre and weathered gray beige, no gilding. LOCK image 1's subject silhouette, all figures, damage, 3:4 framing and generous white margins; do not zoom or crop. Preserve at least 80 pixels COMPLETELY BLANK PURE WHITE on all four canvas edges. Use matte mineral color areas and fine lines. No extra objects, figures, scenery, text, labels, cast shadow, texture outside subject, gradient, transparency or checkerboard. All blank pixels MUST be flat opaque pure #FFFFFF. This is a white matte original.
